create_arkitscenes_dataset: create an ARKitScenesDataset instance from a dataset path to load ARKitScenes data
get_scan_mesh: get the 3D mesh point cloud and RGB colors for a scene by scene ID
get_camera_views: get camera views including RGB images, depth maps, poses, and intrinsics for a scan
load_arkitscenes_point_cloud: load and return xyz coordinates and rgb values as torch tensors from a PLY mesh file
load_arkitscenes_camera_data: load interpolated camera poses, intrinsics, RGB frames, and depth z-buffer data for a scan name
